pasos.prompt: Game prop design of the stone sarcophagus of a betrayed medieval king in the royal catacombs of a castle, for an isometric escape room game. A long rectangular sarcophagus of warm grey stone (the same stone as the references), with a thick lid on which the effigy of the king lies carved in stone: lying on his back, eyes closed, a simple crown, hands joined on the chest holding a long sword. Simple carved panels with arches on the sides, a stepped base. Everything the same single stone color, no gold, no colored details. No inscriptions, no letters, no symbols. Chunky simple bold carved shapes, no fine engravings. Seen in a three-quarter view slightly from above, whole object visible and centered. Exactly the same stylized 3D toon rendering, soft shading and soft upper-left lighting as the reference images. Edges defined only by light and shading, no outline. Isolated on a flat uniform light grey background, no floor, no shadow, no text.
